title: A retried Flux completes and publishes the successful cache operation
summary: The merged cache advice resubscribed after failure, delivered the successful attempt, and kept failed-attempt data out of the cache.

subject.symbol: Cacheable and CacheEvict Flux through the managed retry proxy

change.description: The reactive cache advice now creates its shared publisher and cache subscriber for each subscription, including a retry after an error.

notes: Both the caching and retry advisors run on the managed service. Timeouts are paired with an independent source count and cache read.
